subject: Demo: Dedicated capacity — NovuSync throughput & latency fitcall
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Patel <sasha@novusync.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — Dedicated capacity (throughput/latency)

Hi Sasha — thanks for signing up and providing the initial details on the form. I'm Priyom from Redwood SDRs. Marcus (solutions) and Irene (Customer Ops) are looped in.

Quick summary of what we saw on the intake: NovuSync selected Dedicated capacity, indicated target steady-state ~5k QPS during peak windows, and an SLO target of p50 latency < 80ms for 512-token responses. Before we lock a demo slot, can you confirm the traffic shape? e.g., 95% short queries (<=64 tokens) vs 5% long tail (>=512 tokens), and whether you require client-side KV caching or expect our server-side prefix caching to handle warm-starts.

Proposed times for a 45-min technical fitcall (all times PDT):
- Wed Jul 28: 10:30–11:15 or 15:00–15:45
- Thu Jul 29: 09:00–09:45 or 16:00–16:45

If none of those work, send 2 windows that do and we'll accommodate. I'll attach a short intake doc so Marcus/Irene can prep.

Thanks — Priyom
SDR, Redwood Inference
attachments: novusync_requirements_v2.pdf (PDF, 230KB)

From: Sasha Patel <sasha@novusync.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: platform@novusync.com
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 14:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo request — Dedicated capacity (throughput/latency)

Hi Priyom — thanks for the quick follow-up. Confirming the intake fields are accurate. A couple of clarifications from our side:
- Our production peak is roughly 5k QPS sustained for ~10 minute bursts during sync windows, then tailing to ~400 QPS.
- Traffic is ~85% short queries (<64 tokens), ~10% mid (64–256), ~5% long (>512).
- We need p50 < 80ms and p95 < 200ms for our customer-facing endpoint. p99 can be higher.
- We'll want a discussion on networking topology — we plan to run in a VPC with private endpoints, have strict egress rules, and will need to validate TLS mutual auth integration.

Marcus — is your Dedicated offering able to hit those SLOs on an Nvidia A100-style GPU pool with ongoing prefix caching? Also, do you support reserving burst capacity during our sync windows?

Best,
Sasha Patel
Director of Platform Engineering
NovuSync
phone: +1-415-555-0189

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Patel <sasha@novusync.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — Dedicated capacity (throughput/latency)

Hey Sasha — Ben from Sales Engineering here. Thanks for the detailed traffic shape — that helps a lot. Short answers up-front: yes, we can architect a Dedicated pool to meet p50 < 80ms for mostly short queries; prefix/KV caching and batching are key. We also offer burst reservation that can be scheduled around your sync windows.

Proposing a tech fitcall where Marcus (solutions) walks throughput/latency tradeoffs and Irene covers network/VPC onboarding. Marcus has the following slots (PDT):
- Thu Jul 29 09:00–09:45 (preferred)
- Thu Jul 29 16:00–16:45

I've attached a 1-page runbook to the calendar invite; Marcus — can you confirm whether we need any sample traces or a small benchmark script from NovuSync before the call? If so, Sasha — could you share 5–10 representative queries and a synthetic QPS script? We can run a staged simulation against a compatible instance to validate kernel/quantization choices.

Thanks — Ben
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Patel <sasha@novusync.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — Dedicated capacity (throughput/latency)

Thanks Sasha — sounds like a good fit for a focused walkthrough. I'm confirming the Thu Jul 29 09:00–09:45 PDT slot and have sent a calendar invite (redwood_dedicated-fitcall.ics). Quick prep notes for the NovuSync platform team:

- Please share a short list (5–10) of representative queries and an approximate tokens-per-request distribution prior to the call. If you can also share a small synthetic QPS script (or a brief description of the burst shape), we can bring a benchmark run.
- If you use mTLS and private endpoints, please list the required cert exchange steps and whether we should expect NAT/GW egress during the onboarding run.
- We'll demo a baseline Dedicated pool configuration (kernel choices, quantization profile for your model class, and a proposal for prefix caching + reserved burst).

Irene will walk through onboarding actions and expected lead time for capacity reservation (typically 3–5 business days for a guaranteed burst SLA).

See you on Thu.
Marcus Lin
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-650-555-0192
attachments: redwood_dedicated-fitcall.ics (calendar invite)
